Seed timestamps all lie in the past (126 distinct values, 2026-07-01T10:07:00Z..2026-07-29T11:15:00Z) and increase strictly within every conversation (APP-101 120 messages; APP-201, APP-301, APP-302). Ordering by seed array order, by id or by created_at therefore gives the same result, and a record created on any later run date sorts after the seed. The golden orders by autoincrement id (solution/app/src/index.js:158,189,389,407,411-412), not by wall clock. app.js:21 only displays times in UTC, and no criterion grades a displayed time (grep of criteria and prompts for timestamp/date/today/ago/clock finds none).
